facts.statement: Playwright 可对 Chromium、WebKit、Firefox 运行测试，也可驱动 Google Chrome、Microsoft Edge 等品牌浏览器，并支持平板和手机模拟。
facts.quote: Playwright can run tests on Chromium, WebKit and Firefox browsers as well as branded browsers such as Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge. It can also run on emulated tablet and mobile devices.
facts.usedFor: 对照表：三引擎支持范围；清单分组依据

facts.statement: Chromium 场景默认使用开源 Chromium 构建；Chromium 项目领先品牌浏览器，Google Chrome N 时 Playwright 已支持稍后发布的 Chromium N+1。
facts.quote: For Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge and other Chromium-based browsers, by default, Playwright uses open source Chromium builds. Since the Chromium project is ahead of the branded browsers, when the world is on Google Chrome N, Playwright already supports Chromium N+1 that will be released in Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge a few weeks later.
facts.usedFor: 对照表：Chromium 构建来源与版本节奏；清单 chromium-1

facts.statement: Playwright 为有头操作提供常规 Chromium 构建，headless 模式使用独立的 chromium headless shell；仅跑 headless 时可用 --only-shell 避免下载完整 Chromium。
facts.quote: Playwright ships a regular Chromium build for headed operations and a separate chromium headless shell for headless mode. If you are only running tests in headless shell (i.e. the channel option is not specified), for example on CI, you can avoid downloading the full Chromium browser by passing --only-shell during installation.
facts.usedFor: 对照表：headless 实现差异；清单 chromium-3

facts.statement: 使用 'chromium' channel 可启用新的 headless 模式；该模式可选择用 --no-shell 在安装时跳过 headless shell。
facts.quote: You can opt into the new headless mode by using 'chromium' channel. With the new headless mode, you can skip downloading the headless shell during browser installation by using the --no-shell option.
facts.usedFor: 对照表：headless 实现差异；清单 chromium-3

facts.statement: Playwright 可驱动机器上已安装的 Chrome、Edge（默认不安装它们）；当前版本支持这两个浏览器的 Stable 与 Beta 通道。
facts.quote: While Playwright can download and use the recent Chromium build, it can operate against the branded Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge browsers available on the machine (note that Playwright doesn't install them by default). In particular, the current Playwright version will support Stable and Beta channels of these browsers.
facts.usedFor: 对照表：品牌版与通道；清单 chromium-1

facts.quote: Available channels are chrome, msedge, chrome-beta, msedge-beta, chrome-dev, msedge-dev, chrome-canary, msedge-canary.

facts.statement: 由于授权考虑，开源 Chromium 不具备 Google Chrome 或 Microsoft Edge 打包的全部编解码器；依赖这些编解码器时应使用官方通道。
facts.quote: Chromium does not have all the codecs that Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge are bundling due to various licensing considerations and agreements. If your site relies on this kind of codecs (which is rarely the case), you will also want to use the official channel.
facts.usedFor: 对照表：Chromium 平台相关差异；清单 chromium-2

facts.statement: 某些企业浏览器策略会影响 Playwright 启动与控制 Chrome、Edge；带浏览器策略的环境不在 Playwright 项目支持范围内。
facts.quote: Certain Enterprise Browser Policies may impact Playwright's ability to launch and control Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge. Running in an environment with browser policies is outside of the Playwright project's scope.
facts.usedFor: 对照表：Chromium 平台相关差异；清单 chromium-4

facts.statement: Playwright 的 Firefox 版本匹配近期的 Firefox Stable 构建；由于依赖补丁，Playwright 不支持品牌版 Firefox。
facts.quote: Playwright's Firefox version matches the recent Firefox Stable build. Playwright doesn't work with the branded version of Firefox since it relies on patches.
facts.usedFor: 对照表：Firefox 构建来源、品牌版限制；清单 firefox-1

facts.statement: 部分功能可用性高度依赖底层平台，会随操作系统变化；例如媒体编解码器在 Linux、macOS、Windows 之间差异显著。
facts.quote: Note that availability of certain features, which depend heavily on the underlying platform, may vary between operating systems. For example, available media codecs vary substantially between Linux, macOS and Windows.
facts.usedFor: 对照表：平台相关差异；清单 firefox-2、firefox-3、webkit-3

facts.statement: Playwright 的 WebKit 取自最新 WebKit main 分支源码，通常早于这些更新被并入 Apple Safari 及其他 WebKit 浏览器，为应对潜在升级问题留出时间。
facts.quote: Playwright's WebKit is derived from the latest WebKit main branch sources, often before these updates are incorporated into Apple Safari and other WebKit-based browsers. This gives a lot of lead time to react on the potential browser update issues.
facts.usedFor: 对照表：WebKit 构建来源与版本节奏；清单 webkit-4

facts.statement: Playwright 因依赖补丁而不支持品牌版 Safari；应改用最新 WebKit 构建进行测试。
facts.quote: Playwright doesn't work with the branded version of Safari since it relies on patches. Instead, you can test using the most recent WebKit build.
facts.usedFor: 对照表：品牌版限制；清单 webkit-1

facts.statement: 在 Linux CI 上运行 WebKit 通常最经济；要获得最接近 Safari 的体验（例如视频播放），应在 macOS 上运行 WebKit。
facts.quote: While running WebKit on Linux CI is usually the most affordable option, for the closest-to-Safari experience you should run WebKit on mac, for example if you do video playback.
facts.usedFor: 对照表：WebKit 平台差异；清单 webkit-2、webkit-3

facts.statement: 不带参数的 npx playwright install 安装默认浏览器；也可通过参数安装指定浏览器，例如 npx playwright install webkit。
facts.quote: Playwright can install supported browsers. Running the command without arguments will install the default browsers. You can also install specific browsers by providing an argument: npx playwright install webkit
facts.usedFor: 对照表下方安装命令；清单 env-2

facts.statement: 可用 --with-deps 把浏览器安装与操作系统依赖安装合并为一条命令，例如 npx playwright install --with-deps chromium。
facts.quote: It's also possible to combine install-deps with install so that the browsers and OS dependencies are installed with a single command. npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
facts.usedFor: 对照表下方安装命令；CI 场景

facts.statement: 三引擎默认下载到各系统缓存目录（Windows 为 %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\ms-playwright，macOS 为 ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright，Linux 为 ~/.cache/ms-playwright）；文档示例体积约为 Chromium 281M、Firefox 187M、WebKit 180M。
facts.quote: Playwright downloads Chromium, WebKit and Firefox browsers into the OS-specific cache folders: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\ms-playwright on Windows, ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright on macOS, ~/.cache/ms-playwright on Linux. ... 281M chromium-XXXXXX, 187M firefox-XXXX, 180M webkit-XXXX
facts.usedFor: 对照表下方缓存说明；清单 env-2

facts.statement: 每个 Playwright 版本都需要特定版本的浏览器二进制，需用 Playwright CLI 安装；每次升级 Playwright 可能都需要重新执行安装命令。
facts.quote: Each version of Playwright needs specific versions of browser binaries to operate. You will need to use the Playwright CLI to install these browsers. ... every time you update Playwright, you might need to re-run the install CLI command.

facts.statement: 通过在配置中设置 projects，可在多个浏览器与配置下运行测试；文档提到默认配置包含 Chromium、Firefox、WebKit 三个项目。
facts.quote: Playwright can run your tests in multiple browsers and configurations by setting up projects in the config. ... The default config when installing Playwright gives you 3 projects, Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
facts.usedFor: 清单 env-3；验收范围对齐

scopeStatement: 来源均为公开文档，无登录、无表单提交、无外部内容写入。报告中的支持性描述属于文档范围；未执行浏览器兼容性测试，因此不能作为实测通过结论。
